text: The intersection of Station Road and Stanley Avenue in Ward 6, is a key pedestrian crossing in the Mimico community. Stanley Avenue is a one-way street, with a contraflow bike lane, and four-way stop signs on Station Road. The Mimico Centennial Library is situated at the south east corner of the intersection and Stanley Avenue Park is at the north east corner. Both streets are key pedestrian routes for children attending St. Leo Catholic School, John English Junior Middle School, and Phoenix Montessori School. The speed limit on Stanley Avenue has recently been reduced to 30 km/hr. I am requesting a study of any possible intersection modifications, such as an elevated surface, marking pedestrian crossings, reducing pedestrian crossing distances, separating the contraflow bike lane crossing and vehicular lane crossing, curb radius reductions, reducing through lane width on the far (east)…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District to report back on any possible modifications to the intersection of Station Road and Stanley Avenue to improve pedestrian safety.
